details:
So I had some suggestions on some personal things I liked ^^
1. being able to customise the colour of the loading screen ( so mine use to be pink and so was the mute icon ^^)
2. Instead of the tips and important notes that show up on the loading screen, how about changing them to your VRChat photo memories (was a mod before) or maybe have it beside it or something so you can still view them :)
3. The buttons on the camera, instead of you having to try and get your curser or laser to click a button. what about making it so you can click it with your finger, like some worlds have pushable buttons.
4. This could be a me problem but I'm using a HTC Vive and the quality isn't 110%.. but looking into a mirror is horribly worse.. no clue if there is a solution for that (i may just need a new headset..) 
5. JOIN NOTIFIER!!! so you know who joins you that very second, and to probably have a option to turn it off too. ( and maybe a side menu to show you whos in world instead of having to open the menu and scroll to view..)
6. A remember me button.. i get logged out of VRChat a lot when you open the game.. so it would be nice to have a handy button.. :')
7. Maybe an option to change resolution of the camera pictures? (my quality is horrible so I don't actually end up knowing how good it looks..)
8. I know the safety system is a thing but maybe you can pick how much shaders are limited or any other thing?
9. Not sure if this is a thing but maybe improve how well the bones get optimized or have a button to change the settings and make the quality better? (was a mod for that efkwesfbvk)
10. (i know so many suggestions..) but maybe so you can change the colour of the player ranks? OOOO NICKNAMES WOULD BE COOOOOOOOOOOOOOL
11. Last but not least, (for now) so i tried making my bio fancy and full of stars symbols and clouds and tried to have it in the middle, but.. once i saved it.. it went all funny. maybe add so that we can use more symbols in how bio's 
12. WHAT NO ONE MORE, VRC+ PLEASE MAKE IT IN AUD AS WELL ITS SO MUCH MONEY FOR US AUSSIEEESS
THANK YOU FOR READINGGG!! <3
title: ~ Some Personal Requests ~
